Bug_Details:
DoubleMath.fuzzyEquals should never be used in an Object.equals() method From documentation: DoubleMath.fuzzyEquals is not transitive, so it is not
suitable for use in Object#equals implementations.
Bug_Explanation: The method DoubleMath.fuzzyEquals is used inside the equals method. DoubleMath.fuzzyEquals is not transitive, meaning that even if a.equals(b) and b.equals(c) are true, it's not guaranteed that a.equals(c) will be true. This violates the contract of the equals method.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case uses the showBug method to compare two values (0.1 and 0.10005) that are considered equal by the faulty fuzzyEquals method, but should not be equal according to the transitive property of equality. This demonstrates the violation of the equals contract and thus triggers the bug.
